title: The Case for Assurance Infrastructure
standfirst: The technical argument that checking AI-generated evidence, not producing it, is the binding constraint on government analysis; the research avenues that would relax it; and sixteen tractable projects.
summary: An evidence-backed essay on why verification capacity, provenance and accountable authorisation determine the useful scale of AI-assisted policy analysis.
claimBoundary: Evidence-backed synthesis with internally recomputed derived quantities and a recorded adversarial review. It is not a certificate-backed Evidence Press research release, has no article-specific DOI, and has not been externally peer reviewed or independently reproduced.
